experiment: E3 eager end-to-end latency, N sweep
precision: shipped: flags after load {'float32_matmul_precision': 'highest', 'cuda_matmul_allow_tf32': False, 'cudnn_allow_tf32': True}; param dtypes ['torch.bfloat16']
command: source env/thor_env.sh; cd /tmp; env -u HF_TOKEN -u HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 ~/venvs/groot17/bin/python <repo>/bench/run_e3.py --model groot_n17 --precision shipped --steps 4 --out <repo>/results/20261022_E3_groot_n17_shipped_N4_v2 --hw <repo>/results/20261022_E1_peak/hw_constants.json

provenance.input_note: seeded random pixels / state at the checkpoint's own keys and shapes (np.random.seed(1234), 256x256), as on the Orin (groot_phases.build_observation)

notes: Regions: bench/regions.py; e2e = the model call (LeRobot: predict_action_chunk; GR00T: Gr00tPolicy.get_action). Floors (floor.csv) from one accounting pass at the default N: FLOPs by torch FlopCounterMode, bytes = parameters touched per region (embeddings: rows looked up) + the hand-over (accounting.json); ceilings for the dominant parameter dtype of the part. Every N block started in the normal memory-path state.
